_comment: HUMAN-EDITED ONLY. Kiro hooks block agent writes to this file. allowedOrgs = sandbox aliases or usernames Kiro may deploy, validate, or write data to. productionOrgs = always blocked for Kiro writes. packageDirs = must match packageDirectories[].path in sfdx-project.json.
_howto: Run 'sf org list' to get your aliases. Run 'sf org display --target-org <alias>' to confirm IsSandbox=true before adding to allowedOrgs. Never add a production org to allowedOrgs.

_allowedOrgs_notes.dev: Developer sandbox — primary TDD and development org. Alias set via: sf alias set dev=john.doe@company.com.dev
_allowedOrgs_notes.qa: QA / integration sandbox — used for regression testing before UAT
_allowedOrgs_notes.uat: UAT sandbox — user acceptance testing. Deploy here only after QA sign-off

_productionOrgs_notes.prod: Production alias — read-only for Kiro. Set via: sf alias set prod=john.doe@company.com
_productionOrgs_notes.john.doe@company.com: Production username — added as a safety net in case the alias is bypassed

_packageDirs_notes: Must match packageDirectories[].path in sfdx-project.json. Add more entries if your project has multiple package directories, e.g. ['force-app', 'force-app-managed', 'unpackaged'].
